title: Patient Financial Account Terms — Late Fees on Past-Due Statements
content:
**Condition 1 — The fee.** A late fee of the tier's late-fee amount is posted on the Patient Financial Account once for a statement whose balance is still unpaid after the late-fee day. It is posted with the line category late fee, no encounter number, and the statement date as its date of service.

**Condition 2 — The late-fee day.** The statement balance has remained unpaid for more than the tier's late-fee days after the statement date. The late-fee days are counted in calendar days starting the day after the statement date, and the fee may be posted only from the day after the last counted day. The statement date is the date of the statement's own ledger entry.

| Hypothetical dates, 45 late-fee days, statement dated day 0 | May the fee be posted? |
|---|---|
| day 45 — the last counted day | no |
| day 46 — the day after the last counted day | yes |

**Condition 3 — When no fee is posted.** No late fee is posted:

- when the tier's late-fee amount is 0.00;
- when the account's late fees posted in the rolling 12 calendar months ending on the handling date have reached the tier's maximum per 12 months;
- while the account is on billing hold;
- on a balance enrolled in an active payment plan.

A partial payment of at least the tier's partial-payment percentage of the statement balance, made before the late-fee day, also prevents the fee.

**Condition 4 — After posting.** A late fee is never reversed merely because the balance is later paid, but it is removed with an adjustment coded as a billing error correction if the statement it was posted for is later found wrong.

### Worked case (hypothetical figures)

On a tier with a 10.00 fee, a maximum of 3 per 12 months and a 50.00 percent partial-payment level, a statement of 300.00 dated day 0 receives a payment of 100.00 on day 20. That is below 50.00 percent of 300.00 (150.00), the balance is still unpaid on day 46, the account is not on hold, the balance is not in an active plan, and two late fees were posted in the preceding 12 months: a 10.00 late fee may be posted from day 46. Had the payment been 150.00, no fee would be posted; had three late fees already been posted in the 12 months, none would be posted either.
